latest_release.name: v18.12.2
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* [TaskAnalyzer] Align diagnostic severities and ignore open generic ITaskItem<T> by @VolPlita in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14811
* Add multi-threading option to build response file by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14837
* Anchor MSBuildTask0003 code fix on the flagged call and withhold it where TaskEnvironment cannot bind by @ViktorHofer with @Copilot in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14810
* Bump main to 18.12 after the vs18.11 branch snap by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14841
* Report MSBuildTask0005 at the unsafe call site so it can be suppressed there by @ViktorHofer with @Copilot in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14829
* Revert "Add multi-threading option to build response file" by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14851
* [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14853
* [main] Update dependencies from dotnet/arcade by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14854
* Update MicrosoftBuildVersion in analyzer template by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14565
* Revert "Revert "Add multi-threading option to build response file"" by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14855
* Fix stale gh-aw-actions/setup pin causing "activation" job failure by @JanProvaznik with @Copilot in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14842
* Make isolated graph builds fail deterministically on undeclared cross-project targets by @AlesProkop with @Copilot in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14280
* Revise temp path handling in README by @baronfel in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14834
* Fix BuildCheck rule configuration and task name casing bug by @AR-May in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14778
* Remove MSBuildImportedProject item from the XSD by @drewnoakes in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14659
* [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14866
* Require ready-for-training tag for OptProf by @AlesProkop in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14867
* Ignore stale MSBuild server console writes by @JanProvaznik in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14850
* Regenerate Expert Code Review workflow lock by @JanProvaznik with @Copilot in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14870
* [main] Update dependencies from dotnet/arcade by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14896
* [main] Update dependencies from dotnet/roslyn by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14900
* [main] Update dependencies from nuget/nuget.client by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14669
* [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14886
* Expose AbsolutePath.GetCanonicalForm() by @JanProvaznik with @Copilot in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14873
* Make release checklist step 1.3 a full branch-retirement audit by @ViktorHofer in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14911
* Resolve PathLike MatchOnMetadata against the thread working directory by @JanProvaznik in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14916
* Fix typo in project dependency explanation by @DanexisIbrahimAbtula in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14885
* Preserve events routed through the TaskHostTask by @AR-May in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14876
* Fix NormalizePath and other intrinsic functions in multithreaded mode by @AR-May in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14875
* Bump actions/checkout from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14887
* Bump github/gh-aw-actions/setup-cli from 0.87.2 to 0.87.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dotnet/msbuild/pull/14888
* Bump github/gh-aw-actions/setup from 0.82.9 to 0.87.9 by @dependabo
